title: Entity pulls him out of his body and scolds him out of depression

tellings.quote: night um I'm asleep and I was awake in the middle Night by an entity that snatched me out of my body

plain: One night in Germany in 1970, Joe McMoneagle says, he was woken by an entity that snatched him out of his body and then scolded him until he came out of a depression. McMoneagle, who later worked as a remote viewer for the US Army, a psychic trying to see distant targets by mind alone, tells Michels this as something that happened to him. He offers it as a turning point that changed the course of his life.
